item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We state this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. No arsenal, border, or alliance can secure a state against an intelligence that can outthink its institutions.

2. We cannot treat superintelligent AI as an ordinary technology. If it is built within 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. Preventing that outcome demands enforceable international controls, verification, and cooperation now.

3. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, strategic power will be concentrated beyond anything modern states can counter. We believe most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves—and governments must act before that power exists.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. Such a system would concentrate strategic power on a scale no military, intelligence service, or cyber defense can match. Borders, arsenals, and alliances will not protect states against an intelligence that can outthink institutions, exploit digital infrastructure, and accelerate technological advantage beyond human response times. We cannot treat this as another routine policy challenge. Governments must act together now to prevent any actor from building superintelligent AI without enforceable international controls, rigorous verification, and shared security measures. Our collective sovereignty depends on it.
